'''''Star Wars: Darth Maul''''' is a [[Marvel Comics|Marvel]] [[Star Wars comic books|comic book]] miniseries. The series, written by [[Cullen Bunn]] with art by [[Luke Ross]], began on [[February 1]], [[2017]]. The story focuses on the character of [[Maul|Darth Maul]] and is set before the events of [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'']], in which the character made his first appearance.

Although it was only a five issue miniseries, concluding its storyline with the release of [[Darth Maul (2017) 5|''Darth Maul'' (2017) 5]],<ref name="Maul 5">[[Darth Maul (2017) 5|''Darth Maul'' (2017) 5]]</ref> ''Star Wars: Darth Maul'' later received a single issue sequel in the form of [[Age of Republic - Darth Maul 1|''Age of Republic - Darth Maul'' 1]]. This issue of the ''[[Star Wars: Age of Republic]]'' line detailed Maul's feelings after the events of ''Darth Maul'' 5, continuing the story of his bloodlust to kill [[Jedi]] and returning the character to the [[Planet|world]] of [[Malachor]],<ref name="Age">[[Age of Republic - Darth Maul 1|''Age of Republic - Darth Maul'' 1]]</ref> which he had visited in [[Darth Maul (2017) 2|''Darth Maul'' (2017) 2]].<ref name="Darth Maul II">[[Darth Maul (2017) 2|''Darth Maul'' (2017) 2]]</ref>
